summary: Reader/writer fixture tests commit on a separate writer thread while the reader holds its snapshot. The daily debug-assertions run no longer mistakes these concurrency checks for writes from inside a pinned read. Each test checks that the pinned snapshot stays unchanged and that the committed write becomes visible after the snapshot ends. Fixes #4725.

replay.detail: Test-only changes; no graph replay or backfill.

rules.detail: The production guard against writes from inside a pinned read is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No production behavior, API, wire or storage compatibility changes.

downtime.detail: No deployment or restart is required.

recovery.detail: Revert the fixture changes; no data recovery is needed.
